# Estuscia Group

> Estuscia Group is a business ecosystem based in Kozhikode, Kerala, India. It brings together financial services, business consulting, technology, media, trade and startup development under one group.

Website: https://www.estusciagroup.com/
Email: support@estuscia.com
Phone: +91 9633329669, +91 9633359669
Address: HiLITE City, HiLITE Business Park, Tower 1, 7th Floor, Kozhikode – 673014, Kerala, India
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:30 to 17:30 IST

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.estusciagroup.com/): Overview of the group, its mission, ecosystem, sectors, leadership and contact form.
- [About](https://www.estusciagroup.com/#about): Mission, vision and core belief.
- [Ecosystem](https://www.estusciagroup.com/#eco): The group's brands.
- [Sectors](https://www.estusciagroup.com/#sectors): Sectors the group works in.
- [Leadership](https://www.estusciagroup.com/#leaders): The executive team.
- [Contact](https://www.estusciagroup.com/#contact): Contact details and enquiry form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.estusciagroup.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://www.estusciagroup.com/terms)

## Brands in the ecosystem

- Estuscia Group: parent ecosystem and governance holding.
- Estuscia Capital: financial services and capital advisory.
- Estivoxx Technology: technology company (https://estivoxx.com/).
- Prodxtoria Pictures: media and production.
- Zedeo Cart: e-commerce.
- AnWild Fashion: fashion and apparel.
- Estuscia Global: global trade division.
- Chai With Trade: B2B trade networking platform.
- MaQcala Perfumes: luxury fragrance.
